_meta.description: Official update sources for weekly review. RSS/Atom feeds and Microsoft's documented Release Communications MCP endpoint are scanned automatically; OCI release notes are listed for manual review until a reliable programmatic source is adopted.

azure.label: Azure Updates
azure.note: Microsoft documents this public MCP endpoint as the programmatic source powering Azure Updates; underlying release information refreshes daily.

oci.label: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Release Notes
oci.note: Oracle publishes current OCI release notes here. Review OCI changes manually until a documented, reliable feed or API is adopted for automation.
